title: Canada-wide public beta expansion
scope: Twelve reviewed Canadian organizations selected to broaden the public atlas across aerospace, space, communications, cyber, manufacturing, test, training, and sustainment.

records.name: QinetiQ Target Systems Canada
records.description: Medicine Hat-based Canadian operation that designs and produces naval, aerial, and land target systems for realistic test, evaluation, live training, and mission rehearsal.

capability.name: Threat-representation target systems
capability.summary: Canadian-produced fixed-wing, rotary-wing, land, and remotely operated surface targets with supporting command-and-control, scoring, launcher, and mission-vehicle systems.
features: Air, land, and naval target families

source.title: QinetiQ Target Systems (QTS)
source.excerpt: QinetiQ describes its Medicine Hat operation and Canadian production of naval, aerial, and land target systems, remotely operated surface vessels, command-and-control systems, scoring systems, and launchers.

records.name: Wyvern
records.description: Edmonton-headquartered Canadian Earth-observation company providing commercial hyperspectral satellite imagery and data products for monitoring, analytics, and peace-and-security applications.

capability.name: Commercial hyperspectral satellite imagery
capability.summary: Spaceborne hyperspectral imagery products with high spatial and spectral quality, consistent monitoring support, flexible licensing, and unclassified data-sharing options.

missionMatches.alignmentSummary: Commercial hyperspectral imagery can add shareable, unclassified environmental and site-monitoring data to northern awareness workflows, subject to collection availability and mission-specific analytics.

source.title: About Wyvern
source.excerpt: Wyvern identifies itself as an Edmonton-headquartered Canadian aerospace company providing hyperspectral imagery products from a spaceborne satellite constellation for monitoring and analytical uses.

records.name: MANNARINO Systems & Software
records.description: Saint-Laurent-based Canadian engineering company specializing in safety-critical airborne software, electronic hardware, systems engineering, certification support, and aircraft-system simulation.

capability.name: Safety-critical airborne systems engineering
capability.summary: Engineering and certification services for airborne software, real-time applications, electronic hardware, systems simulation, avionics, engine controls, and other safety-critical aircraft systems.

source.title: Leading Safety-Critical Systems Engineering Company
source.excerpt: MANNARINO lists airborne and real-time software, airborne electronic hardware, systems engineering, avionics, aircraft simulation, and Transport Canada Design Approval Organization services.

records.name: Bell Textron Canada
records.description: Mirabel-based Canadian rotorcraft design, engineering, composite manufacturing, assembly, flight-test, certification, customization, delivery, and in-service support operation.

capability.name: Canadian rotorcraft design and sustainment
capability.summary: Integrated Canadian capability for rotorcraft design, engineering, composite manufacturing, assembly, flight testing, certification, customization, delivery, and long-term fleet support.

source.title: Bell in Canada
source.excerpt: Bell describes its Mirabel operation as an integrated Canadian centre for helicopter design, manufacturing, delivery, flight support, and long-term Canadian Armed Forces fleet sustainment.

records.name: Kognitiv Spark
records.description: Fredericton-headquartered Canadian technology company building secure augmented- and mixed-reality remote-support tools for frontline workers in defence, marine, manufacturing, and other demanding environments.

capability.name: RemoteSpark frontline support platform
capability.summary: Hands-free augmented-reality platform connecting frontline workers with remote experts and critical documents in real time across constrained bandwidth and demanding operating conditions.

missionMatches.alignmentSummary: RemoteSpark can deliver expert guidance and technical information to frontline users under constrained connectivity, making it relevant to human-in-the-loop support at the operational edge.

source.title: About Kognitiv Spark
source.excerpt: Kognitiv Spark describes RemoteSpark as a secure hands-free augmented-reality platform that connects frontline workers to remote experts and critical information regardless of location, bandwidth, or conditions.

records.name: Beauceron Security
records.description: Fredericton-based Canadian cybersecurity company providing anti-phishing, security-awareness, email-analysis, workforce-risk, and behaviour-change software for organizations and service providers.

capability.name: Human-centric cyber-risk platform
capability.summary: Cybersecurity-awareness and anti-phishing platform combining adaptive simulations, personalized risk dashboards, training, real-time remediation, reported-email analysis, and managed-service controls.

source.title: Beauceron Security Solutions
source.excerpt: Beauceron describes anti-phishing, security-awareness, personalized risk, real-time remediation, email-analysis, and managed-service capabilities designed to reduce organizational cyber risk.

records.name: SSi Canada
records.description: Yellowknife-headquartered Canadian communications company that designs, builds, operates, and supports satellite, broadband, mobile-wireless, and last-mile networks for remote regions.

capability.name: Remote-area network systems
capability.summary: Turnkey satellite, microwave, fibre, broadband, and mobile-wireless network design, deployment, operation, software, licensing, logistics, and lifecycle-support capability for remote environments.

missionMatches.alignmentSummary: Remote-area network design and operation can provide the communications backbone needed to move sensor, operational, and coordination data across northern environments.

source.title: Custom Solutions
source.excerpt: SSi describes more than thirty years of designing, building, and operating satellite, broadband, mobile-wireless, backbone, and last-mile solutions for remote areas in Canada's North.

records.name: Calian Advanced Technologies
records.description: Canadian defence and technology operation providing engineering, test, integration, advanced manufacturing, and lifecycle support for electronics, communications, RF, space, and mission-critical systems.

capability.name: Defence advanced manufacturing and integration
capability.summary: Canadian production, engineering, integration, testing, and sustainment capability for defence electronics, communications systems, RF components, space technologies, assemblies, harnesses, circuit cards, vetronics, radar products, and composites.
features: Canadian multi-site production and lifecycle support

source.title: Advanced manufacturing for defence capability
source.excerpt: Calian describes Canadian engineering, manufacturing, integration, testing, and lifecycle support for defence electronics, communications, RF, space technologies, assemblies, harnesses, circuit cards, vetronics, radar, and composites.

records.name: StandardAero
records.description: Winnipeg-based aerospace sustainment operation providing military and commercial gas-turbine engine maintenance, repair, overhaul, engineering, component support, testing, and fleet-management services.

capability.name: T56 and 501-D propulsion sustainment
capability.summary: Military propulsion maintenance, repair, overhaul, component remanufacturing, full test, engineering, technical-publication, fleet-management, and predictive-maintenance support for T56 and 501-D engine families.

source.title: T56 and 501-D
source.excerpt: StandardAero describes Winnipeg-based T56 and 501-D overhaul, component repair, testing, engineering, fleet-management, and propulsion-system support for Canadian and allied military operators.

records.name: NordSpace
records.description: Markham-headquartered Canadian space company developing launch vehicles, liquid rocket engines, satellite systems, an Atlantic spaceport, and high-speed defence-research platforms.

capability.name: Responsive Canadian space systems
capability.summary: Development-stage Canadian space stack spanning launch vehicles, three-dimensional-printed liquid rocket engines, a small-satellite bus, Atlantic launch infrastructure, and edge-of-space research platforms.
features: Spaceport, satellite, and high-altitude research programs

source.title: NordSpace technology overview
source.excerpt: NordSpace describes development of Canadian launch vehicles, liquid rocket engines, a Newfoundland and Labrador spaceport, satellite systems, and SHARP high-speed defence-research platforms.

records.name: General Dynamics Mission Systems-Canada
records.description: Ottawa-headquartered Canadian defence systems integrator delivering tactical communications, networking, embedded computing, data integration, vetronics, cyber, and mission-system support.

capability.name: Land C4ISR and tactical networking
capability.summary: Canadian tactical communications, secure networking, embedded computing, vetronics, sensor and radio integration, data consolidation, and near-real-time situational-awareness capability for land operations.

missionMatches.alignmentSummary: Land C4ISR systems that combine vehicle, sensor, radio, and dismounted data into a near-real-time operating picture are directly relevant to processing and distributing information at the tactical edge.

source.title: Land systems
source.excerpt: General Dynamics describes secure tactical networks, DIGITALspine data integration, tactical communications, embedded computing, vetronics, video, and near-real-time situational-awareness capabilities for land forces.

records.name: MDS Aero Support
records.description: Ottawa-headquartered Canadian engineering company supplying turnkey test facilities, systems, equipment, software, data acquisition, environmental simulation, and lifecycle support for gas-turbine engines.

capability.name: Turnkey gas-turbine engine test systems
capability.summary: End-to-end design and delivery of full-engine, component, environmental, and special-purpose gas-turbine test facilities with integrated controls, instrumentation, data acquisition, construction, and operational support.

source.title: MDS gas-turbine engine solutions
source.excerpt: MDS describes Ottawa-based turnkey gas-turbine engine and component test facilities, environmental simulation, special equipment, integrated data acquisition, facility delivery, and lifecycle support.
